title: Saatçi Bilge
author: Hülya Biyan
description: Two curious little frogs named Zıpzıp and Hophop seek the advice of the Wise Frog Clockmaker to learn about time management and understand the concept of time. Through his guidance, they learn to use their time effectively and discover the joy of planning their days. With this knowledge, the little frogs become more efficient and balance their responsibilities with playtime.
